sinopsis.es: Linda quiere ser la protagonista de la obra de teatro del colegio; pero, cuando Carlos descubre el rol “masculino” que su hija interpretará, intenta impedirlo. Conmovida por la tristeza de su hija, María decide ayudarla, aunque eso signifique nadar a contracorriente.
sinopsis.en: Linda wants the lead in the school play, but when Carlos discovers the "male" role his daughter will perform, he tries to stop her. Moved by her daughter's sadness, María decides to help her, even if it means swimming against the current.
